steps.eval: (()=>{const g=__rhf.game; g.setQuality('high'); g.dpr=1; g.renderer.setPixelRatio(1); g.resize(); g.bears.directorT=9999; g.env.weather.cloud=0.3; g.env.weather.cloudTarget=0.3; g.env.weather.rain=0; g.env.weather.rainTarget=0; g.env.weather.timer=9999; g.hud.firstShown=-1000; g.hud.hint('',0); __rhf.god(true); const W=g.world; const P=W.place('landing'); let forest=null; for(let r=40;r<600&&!forest;r+=20){ for(let a=0;a<24;a++){ const x=P.x+Math.cos(a/24*6.283)*r, z=P.z+Math.sin(a/24*6.283)*r; if(!W.inBounds(x,z)) continue; const k=W.cellIndex(x,z); if(W.forest[k]>210 && !W.waterAt(x,z)){ forest={x,z}; break; } } } window.__forest=forest; window.__go=async(id,time,pitch,yawOff,spot)=>{ if(spot){ g.player.place(spot.x,spot.z,yawOff||0); } else { const p=g.world.place(id); g.player.place(p.x,p.z,(p.face ?? 0)+(yawOff||0)); } g.player.pitch=pitch; g.env.setTime(time); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,3000)); return id+' '+time; }; return 'ok'})()
